purpose: Regression evaluation for replaceable semantic Research producers over exact official disclosure packets.

cases.gold_largest_unknown: Whether future operating cash flow after capex can sustain dividends and repurchases without weakening return on incremental capital.
gold_next_evidence: Next-quarter operating cash flow and capex.
cases.gold_reason_summary: The cash payout is real capital-return evidence but mostly implements a pre-cutoff plan and does not yet change the frozen thesis.

gold_claims.statement: Shareholders approved an A-share repurchase program sized at RMB20–40bn for cancellation and registered-capital reduction.
CATL committed RMB2.475bn of own funds for 49.5% of an 8-year Hainan green-industry fund.

cases.gold_largest_unknown: How much of the RMB20–40bn repurchase will actually be executed, over what period and funding mix, and how that cash use interacts with capex and future operating cash flow.
gold_next_evidence: Official repurchase progress or completion filings.
Next-quarter operating cash flow and capex or capacity-utilization evidence.
Fund capital-call and deployment evidence if economically material.
cases.gold_reason_summary: The batch merits one bounded Quick Research pass because it directly intersects capital allocation, but approval and commitment are not actual cash deployment and do not justify Deep Research yet.
